topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I found a list, tucked away in an old, half-forgotten drawer. It wasn't my list, but hers. A bucket list, they call it. Things to do before the well runs dry. Some of the items make me smile, like the way the sun through the leaves used to. Others, I can’t quite bring myself to look at. It’s there, in her handwriting, a testament to all the places she wanted to see, the things she wanted to do. I wonder if she ever thought about who she’d do them with. I guess I always believed we’d cross them off together. Now, I’m not so sure. The list is here, her dreams are there, and I’m somewhere in the space between, holding on to a piece of paper that whispers of a future that might never come.
